meetings.title: Annual portfolio review completed
meetings.summary: Completed the annual portfolio review with Anneke Hoffman on the Capital Group New Perspective (Global Equity) allocation. Discussed global positioning relative to the insurer's capital constraints.

decisions.text: Maintain the New Perspective allocation with a modest funding top-up.

action_items.text: Coordinate funding paperwork for the top-up

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Anneke Hoffman
transcript_excerpt.text: We're comfortable topping up New Perspective within our capital limits.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Daniel Cho
transcript_excerpt.text: Understood - I'll coordinate the funding paperwork.

meetings.title: Benchmark customization review
meetings.summary: Reviewed a benchmark customization for the global equity allocation with Anneke Hoffman to better reflect the insurer's reference portfolio. Requested an updated fee proposal.

action_items.text: Prepare fee proposal reflecting the customized benchmark

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Anneke Hoffman
transcript_excerpt.text: If we customize the benchmark, I'll need the fee implications in writing.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Daniel Cho
transcript_excerpt.text: I'll send an updated fee proposal tied to the new benchmark.

meetings.title: Hosted at Capital Group symposium
meetings.summary: Hosted Anneke Hoffman at the Capital Group symposium. Strong engagement on global equity themes; agreed to a follow-up deck summarizing the sessions most relevant to Sentinel.

action_items.text: Send follow-up deck summarizing relevant symposium sessions

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Anneke Hoffman
transcript_excerpt.text: The global themes session was excellent - can you send the materials?

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Daniel Cho
transcript_excerpt.text: Of course - I'll put together a tailored follow-up deck.
